title: Savior, Like a Shepherd Lead Us
lyrics_original: Savior, like a shepherd lead us;
Much we need Thy tender care;
In Thy pleasant pastures feed us,
For our use Thy folds prepare:
Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus,
Thou hast bought us, Thine we are,
Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus,
Thou hast bought us, Thine we are.
We are Thine, do Thou befriend us;
Be the Guardian of our way;
Keep Thy flock, from sin defend us,
Seek us when we go astray.
Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus,
Hear us when we praise and pray,
Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus,
Hear us when we praise and pray.
Thou hast promised to receive us,
Poor and sinful though we be;
Thou hast mercy to relieve us,
Grace to cleanse, and make us free:
Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus,
Early let us turn to Thee
Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus,
Early let us turn to Thee.
Early let us seek Thy favor;
Early let us do Thy will;
Gracious Lord, our only Savior,
With Thyself our bosoms fill:
Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus,
Thou hast loved us, love us still,
Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus,
Thou hast loved us, love us still.

bible_verses.english: A Psalm by David. Yahweh is my shepherd; I shall not want.
I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
For you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for being my Good Shepherd and calling me Your own. Forgive me for the times I wander or try to direct my own steps. Feed my soul with Your truth and defend me from every fear and distraction today. Lead me into Your restful presence, and give me a heart that gladly listens for Your gentle voice. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for being my Good Shepherd and calling me Your own. Forgive me for the times I wander or try to direct my own steps. devotional.reflection_english: Life often leaves us feeling weary or unsure, but we belong to a Shepherd who knows us by name. Jesus did not just guide us from afar; He paid the ultimate price to redeem us and make us His own. As we rest in His gentle care, we can lay down our anxieties and trust His leading into peaceful pastures. Let us surrender our day to Him, resting securely in the love of the One who faithfully guards our souls.
